description: This file defines internal testing utilities and macros for Google Test, including classes for mocking test failure reporting and macros for verifying test failures in unit tests.

classes.name: ScopedFakeTestPartResultReporter
classes.description: A helper class to mock out Google Test failure reporting, intercepting test failure results for testing purposes.

classes.name: SingleFailureChecker
classes.description: A helper class to verify that a TestPartResultArray contains exactly one failure of a specified type and message substring.

methods.name: ReportTestPartResult
methods.description: Method to append a test part result to the result array, from ScopedFakeTestPartResultReporter.

methods.name: SingleFailureChecker
methods.description: Constructor and destructor to verify failure results.
